dedupeText: mid century soul jazz album layout 1960s soul jazz urban photography slab serif framed composition navy blue street scene the arch shaped photo window creates a portal effect against the flat navy background the musician s diagonal pose and raised instrument lead the eye upward toward the main title the thin yellow inner border defines the hierarchy between the metadata and the central image navy background arched photo window stacked slab serif typography solid red outlined yellow 1960s soul jazz aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 1960s-style album cover featuring a central arch-shaped photograph of a musician in an urban setting, framed by a thick navy blue border containing multi-tiered, high-contrast typography in red, yellow, and white.
coreVisualRelationships: The arch-shaped photo window creates a portal effect against the flat navy background.
The musician's diagonal pose and raised instrument lead the eye upward toward the main title.
The thin yellow inner border defines the hierarchy between the metadata and the central image.
coreInvariants: Primary color palette of red, yellow, and white text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered in the lower half within an arched frame, scaled to fill the width of the window.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the red title, moves down through the secondary text, follows the saxophone's diagonal line into the photo, and ends on the artist's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous navy blue margins provide breathing room for the dense typographic stack.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Navy blue background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary title to command attention.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow for the artist name and framing lines; light blue for secondary metadata.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation primary colors against a low-value, dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and geometric sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extra-bold slab serifs with tight tracking.
Secondary title uses outlined slab serifs for visual lightness.
Body text uses condensed, high-contrast sans-serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Outlined 'O' and 'C' characters to create rhythmic voids in the artist name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking contrasting weights and treatments (solid vs. outline) of similar slab-serif families.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight of the primary title.
Provides the geometric slab structure for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat navy blue background with a thin yellow rectangular frame. Inside the frame, place a central arched window containing a grainy 1960s-style street photograph of a man holding a saxophone diagonally upward.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of centered text at the top: a large red slab-serif title, a medium yellow outlined slab-serif name below it, and small cyan sans-serif metadata at the very top and bottom of the text block.

verificationChecks: Is the photo frame arched at the top?
Is the primary title solid red and extra bold?
Is the artist name outlined in yellow?
Is the background a consistent dark navy blue?

adjustableVariables: Photo subject (musician, instrument, or street scene)
mustRedesign: Original artist name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the saxophone or subject breaks the vertical space dynamically.
Check that the red and yellow colors don't bleed into the navy background.
Verify the arched frame is perfectly centered.
Confirm the slab serifs have the characteristic 'blocky' feel of the era.
recipe.reuseFormula: Navy background + Arched photo window + Stacked slab-serif typography (Solid Red / Outlined Yellow) = 1960s Soul Jazz Aesthetic.
